title: Follow the money until it becomes usable cash
audience: Business owners, finance teams and customers learning a cash or settlement mechanism
inputs: An approved description of the mechanism, cash dates and amounts on one basis, opening balance, constraints and brand assets
heading: bottom

sources.claim: Illustrative opening cash $60k, collections $40k, payments $70k and closing cash $30k during the same example month
sources.source: Authored arithmetic example: 60 + 40 - 70 = 30; not a company result

sources.claim: The clearing gate is a qualitative illustration of payment availability
sources.source: Conceptual mechanism; replace with approved settlement terms

note: Arc: a payment approaches a gate, the timing question lands, comparable flows expose the gap, the balance changes, a short breath, then the decision. Wide mechanism -> close statement -> evidence -> numerical insert -> pause -> button. The cash-lock sketch is qualitative, not scaled to the example values or a promise about clearing times. The sample closes at $30k because $60k + $40k - $70k = $30k. Replace the complete example together. See docs/financial-playbooks.md for source and adaptation guidance.
